tools.name: get_todays_session
tools.title: Get today's training session
tools.description: Return the signed-in athlete's planned training session(s) for today, including discipline, name, duration, distance, intensity, and workout details.

tools.name: list_upcoming_sessions
tools.title: List upcoming training sessions
tools.description: List the signed-in athlete's planned sessions from today through the next N days (default 7, max 60).

days.description: How many days ahead to include. Defaults to 7.

tools.name: list_recent_completions
tools.title: List recent completed sessions
tools.description: List the signed-in athlete's most recently completed training sessions with actuals (duration, distance, HR, RPE).

limit.description: How many recent completions to return (default 10, max 50).

tools.name: get_training_load
tools.title: Get current training load (CTL/ATL/TSB)
tools.description: Return the athlete's most recent training-load snapshot: chronic training load (CTL), acute training load (ATL), training stress balance (TSB), and a fatigue band interpretation.

tools.name: get_goal_race
tools.title: Get goal race
tools.description: Return the signed-in athlete's current HYROX goal race: name, date, location, target finish time, and days until race day.

tools.name: list_strava_activities
tools.title: List synced Strava activities
tools.description: Return the signed-in athlete's Strava activities synced into the app over a recent window, optionally filtered to one discipline (run, bike, rowing, strength, mobility, hyrox_station, custom).

days.description: Size of the look-back window in days (1-180). Defaults to 14.

discipline.description: Optional discipline filter, e.g. run or bike. Null returns every discipline.

tools.name: get_weekly_rollup
tools.title: Get weekly training rollup per discipline
tools.description: Summarise the signed-in athlete's logged training over a trailing number of weeks: sessions, hours, kilometres and average heart rate per discipline, plus hours per week.

weeks.description: Number of trailing weeks to summarise (1-26). Defaults to 4.
